THE SWEET FOUNDRY

Baking Happiness with Love & Sprinkles

Pinky Bites was founded in 2026 by Chef Lily and a dreamy team of pastry creators. Our simple dream was to bake cupcakes that didn't just taste heavenly, but felt like a cheerful hug on a sunny afternoon.

We sourced organic pasture butter, fresh strawberries, and premium vanilla pods, combining them with a touch of pastel rainbow magic. Every piece is baked to whimsical perfection, making sure they spark real childlike smiles.
